result:
Tags are implemented and `pnpm typecheck` passes. I did not boot the app; the validator cases were checked with a scratch script outside the repo, which confirmed the expected behavior (duplicates collapse, six tags and a 31-character name are refused under `tags`, a 30-character name is saved).

Summary: I added `tags` and `post_tags` tables in `db/schema.ts`, with the migration generated by `void db generate` (`db/migrations/20261019143047_burly_echo.sql` plus journal and snapshot). The `tags` field is parsed and validated in `lib/validators.ts` inside `postPayloadSchema`, so refusals use the same 422 path as an empty title. `lib/posts.ts` gained `withTags` (adds sorted `tags: string[]` to rows) and `syncPostTags` (replaces a post's tags, creating unseen names). The create, update and delete actions in `pages/posts/index.server.ts` and `pages/posts/[id].server.ts` use these helpers, and delete clears `post_tags` first. The list loader in `pages/posts/index.server.ts` accepts `?tag=` as a filter and keeps it across pagination and search. The list (`pages/posts/index.tsx`) and post page (`pages/posts/[id].tsx`) show tags as links to `/posts?tag=…`, and the create and edit forms (`pages/posts/create.tsx`, `pages/posts/[id]/edit.tsx`) have a Tags input.
